summary: Iteration 217 — RE-VERIFY of ALL 17 taxi modes after two fixes (plat/plng/paddr URL pre-fill + ModeSpecificPanel useLocale money() fix). Result: ALL 17 modes PASS end-to-end on https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com. Logged in as test_iter217_1781033305@demo.sb / Client123! and navigated to /course?mode=<id> with Tour Eiffel (48.8584,2.2945) as pickup and Gare du Nord (48.8809,2.3553) as dropoff (14 modes) — or pickup-only (3 modes). Both root-causes from iteration_216 are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) auto-geolocation is now skipped when pickup is pre-filled via URL params, so estimates are realistic Paris distances (~6.37 km, SB ~11.17 €); (2) panel-intercity mounts without a React error and the per-km chip renders correctly ('1,50 €/km' via money()).
critical_code_review_comments: Both fixes from the brief are correctly applied at /app/frontend/src/pages/user/RideChoosePage.js — line 98-100 (plat/plng/paddr pickup pre-fill), line 205 (autoLocate skipped when pickup is pre-filled), line 974 (ModeSpecificPanel calls useLocale → money() is in scope), line 1081 (intercity per-km chip uses money()).

Two background 401s observed (likely /api/auth/me or wallet polling after auth flips) — not blocking but worth confirming no regression in token refresh.

rca of the issue: Both root-causes flagged in iteration_216 are FIXED. (1) Auto-geolocation US-fallback no longer affects automated tests because pickup pre-fill via plat/plng/paddr is now honoured and the autoLocate effect at L205 is gated by `if (!pickup)`. (2) The ModeSpecificPanel intercity crash (money() out of scope) is fixed — the component now calls useLocale() at L974 and the per-km chip at L1081 renders '1,50 €/km' without a React error boundary throw. All 17 taxi modes complete an end-to-end booking flow with correct navigation.
